description: Place a real table request with Dubai Table. Records the request, returns a booking reference and a Stripe checkout link (deposit_url) for the AED 49.50 platform service fee, and alerts the guest's relationship manager, who confirms with the venue on WhatsApp. Requires the guest's name and mobile number with country code. Accepts an exact table_id, a zone, or neither (the relationship manager places the party).

currency.description: Kept for compatibility. The platform service fee is always charged in AED: AED 49.50.

phone.description: Guest mobile with country code, e.g. +971501234567

table_id.description: Exact table id as listed in table availability

whatsappConsent.description: True only if the guest explicitly agrees to WhatsApp booking updates from Dubai Table.

name: request_table
title: Request a table
